new_findings.title: Legacy run digests make identical post-upgrade retries conflict
new_findings.defect: Replay compares every nonempty stored request_digest directly with the new usage-v1 fingerprint. Existing runs created by the previous route store the v1 semantic digest from compute_request_digest (media IDs and recognition only), so the digest cannot equal the new fingerprint even when the retry payload is unchanged. No migration or dual-read path rewrites or recognizes those stored values.
new_findings.failure_scenario: A run accepted before rollout under idempotency key K stores its v1 digest. After rollout, the caller retries K with the same media IDs and image bytes after losing the 202; lookup finds the old run, but _replay_or_conflict returns 409 instead of replaying that run.
new_findings.fix: Version persisted run fingerprints and add an explicit compatibility path for legacy v1 digests, or migrate existing runs to a comparable fingerprint before switching the replay comparison. Add a regression test that seeds a run with compute_request_digest v1 and verifies an identical retry returns the stored run.
